content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 12.4 (p0045) imposes a Customer-only, 24-month bar on soliciting, hiring, or employing *any* Vendor employee, with "regardless of how the employee applies" expressly killing any general-advertising/unsolicited-approach carve-out. That is a no-hire covering all Vendor personnel — walk-away territory — and it fails every fallback element (not mutual, not limited to involved personnel, over 12 months, no carve-outs, prohibits hiring). It also directly contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges Customer made no no-hire commitment and may hire anyone responding to general recruitment.

**Redline (preferred, validated ok:true):** minimal in-sentence replacement so 12.4 reads "Customer is not subject to any non-solicitation, no-hire, or similar restriction with respect to Vendor personnel." — removing the restriction and curing the internal conflict, with the mutual 12-month involvement-limited non-solicit offered as fallback in the comment.
